entities.rationale: Nauru imports nearly all its food and depends on diesel-powered desalination and on Australian money, and it already went through a fiscal and blackout crisis in the 2000s; the 2024 treaty with Australia and the higher interior ground reduce the risk of a long collapse. Very low life expectancy and a weak health system make near-free, universal essentials a long shot even with superintelligence.

Tuvalu is a low atoll nation facing about half a metre or more of sea-level rise, with saltwater flooding of land, crops and water supplies, droughts and total dependence on imports; land reclamation and the Falepili Union with Australia (migration plus a security guarantee) cushion it but cannot remove the habitability risk. Poor water access, low life expectancy and a tiny economy make strict abundance very unlikely.
